behavioralConstraints: subjects are task transition validation reviews merge, with explicit diagnostic scopes; clear means findings.length equals zero within that scope only

task eligibility delegates next-task predicates: READY/PLANNED with every direct/transitive dependency DONE; named DONE is ineligible and eligible work can rank behind nextTaskId; assignment/start gates remain separate

required validator specs come from the same injected developer-validation resolver; local defaults require repository:build and repository:test; ValidationExecutor constructor validates specs but run is never called
optional validator evidence never produces a required blocker; DEV_VALIDATED active review stages MERGE_READY and MERGE_BLOCKED also audit the revision-bound DEV_VALIDATED history event

review audit covers declared QA Architect UAT/Product including future stages as gaps, without making future approval an earlier-stage prerequisite or inventing MergeController approval; Developer handoff/context/actor checks remain gate responsibilities

only latest validated lineage evidence is used; currency NONE CURRENT STALE UNKNOWN_REVISION is independent of outcome PASS FAIL BLOCKED or null; absent sequence/revision is null and stale condition takes precedence over old outcome
transition preview requires registered review-role policy and calls existing pure lifecycle rules; returned records are discarded and supplied prerequisites remain unverified caller assertions

merge delegates unchanged BOOT-024 readiness including exact-revision MERGE_READY and no-review path; structured reasons preserve relevant identities; absent PR/CI configuration is blocked and BOOT-025 must recheck at action time
findings always carry task identity and relevant dependency role validator lineage/sequence revision finding CI PR or prerequisite references plus actionable owning-workflow references
canonical revisions are exact local commits or null, without fetch or HEAD fallback; fixed timestamp and equivalent producer inputs produce equivalent observations
consecutive captures and lifecycle/merge rechecks reject observed local changes, without transaction isolation writer exclusion or future remote freshness guarantees
successful missing failed stale or blocked observations are data; malformed/changing authoritative inputs fail closed without partial success
the command payload is diagnosticsVersion 1.0.0; the CLI envelope remains schemaVersion 1.0.0 and no persisted schema is added
